zotero.abstractNote: Function-space variational inference (FSVI) in Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) aims to approximate the posterior distribution over functions rather than weights. However, existing FSVI methods often suffer from ill-defined objectives or require restrictive assumptions on the function-space prior. We propose a novel FSVI framework based on a regularized KL-divergence that is well-defined for a wide class of BNNs. Our approach provides a principled way to incorporate function-space priors and leads to improved predictive uncertainty estimates.
